entries.text: Though it has a calm disposition, it won’t tolerate\nthose who drum up discord. It strictly disciplines\noffenders until they learn their lesson.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_904_000
entries.text: Overqwil’s poisonous spikes will reflexively react\neven while Overqwil sleeps, stabbing any moving\nthing that approaches.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_906_000
entries.text: Its fluffy fur is similar in composition to plants.\nThis Pokémon frequently washes its face to keep\nit from drying out.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_907_000
entries.text: Floragato deftly wields the vine hidden beneath\nits long fur, slamming the hard flower bud against\nits opponents.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_908_000
entries.text: This Pokémon uses the reflective fur lining its\ncape to camouflage the stem of its flower,\ncreating the illusion that the flower is floating.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_909_000
entries.text: It lies on warm rocks and uses the heat absorbed\nby its square-shaped scales to create fire energy.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_910_000
entries.text: The combination of Crocalor’s fire energy and\noverflowing vitality has caused an egg-shaped\nfireball to appear on the Pokémon’s head.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_911_000
entries.text: The fiery bird changes shape when Skeledirge\nsings. Rumor has it that the bird was born when\nthe fireball on Skeledirge’s head gained a soul.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_912_000
entries.text: This Pokémon migrated to Paldea from distant\nlands long ago. The gel secreted by its feathers\nrepels water and grime.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_913_000
entries.text: These Pokémon constantly run through shallow\nwaters to train their legs, then compete with each\nother to see which of them kicks most gracefully.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_914_000
entries.text: A single kick from a Quaquaval can send a truck\nrolling. This Pokémon uses its powerful legs to\nperform striking dances from far-off lands.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_915_000
entries.text: It searches for food all day. It possesses a keen\nsense of smell but doesn’t use it for anything\nother than foraging.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_916_000
entries.text: Oinkologne is proud of its fine, glossy skin.\nIt emits a concentrated scent from the tip of\nits tail.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_917_000
entries.text: This Pokémon uses its hard tail to make its nest\nby boring holes into bedrock deep underground.\nThe nest can reach lengths of over six miles.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_918_000
entries.text: The ball of threads wrapped around its body is\nelastic enough to deflect the scythes of Scyther,\nthis Pokémon’s natural enemy.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_919_000
entries.text: It clings to branches and ceilings using its\nthreads and moves without a sound. It takes\nout its prey before the prey even notices it.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_920_000
entries.text: It has its third set of legs folded up. When it’s in\na tough spot, this Pokémon jumps over 30 feet\nusing the strength of its legs.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_921_000
entries.text: When it decides to fight all out, it stands on its\npreviously folded legs to enter Showdown Mode.\nIt neutralizes its enemies in short order.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_922_000
entries.text: This Pokémon creates a mud ball by mixing\nsand and dirt with psychic energy. It treasures\nits mud ball more than its own life.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_923_000
entries.text: The body that supports the ball barely moves.\nTherefore, it is thought that the true body of this\nPokémon is actually inside the ball.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_924_000
entries.text: It is said that a dog Pokémon that died in the\nwild without ever interacting with a human was\nreborn as this Pokémon.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_925_000
entries.text: Houndstone spends most of its time sleeping\nin graveyards. Among all the dog Pokémon,\nthis one is most loyal to its master.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_926_000
entries.text: Flittle’s toes levitate about half an inch above\nthe ground because of the psychic power\nemitted from the frills on the Pokémon’s belly.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_927_000
entries.text: It immobilizes opponents by bathing them in\npsychic power from its large eyes. Despite its\nappearance, it has a vicious temperament.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_928_000
entries.text: Now that the brain waves from the head and\ntail are synced up, the psychic power of this\nPokémon is 10 times stronger than Girafarig’s.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_929_000
entries.text: This Pokémon can pick up the scent of a Veluza\njust over 65 feet away and will hide itself in\nthe sand.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_930_000
entries.text: It has a vicious temperament, contrary to what its\nappearance may suggest. It wraps its long bodies\naround prey, then drags the prey into its den.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_931_000
entries.text: This Pokémon is a glutton, but it’s bad at\ngetting food. It teams up with a Tatsugiri\nto catch prey.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_932_000
entries.text: When Veluza discards unnecessary flesh, its mind\nbecomes honed and its psychic power increases.\nThe spare flesh has a mild but delicious flavor.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_933_000
entries.text: It likes playing with others of its kind using the\nwater ring on its tail. It uses ultrasonic waves to\nsense the emotions of other living creatures.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_934_000
entries.text: This Pokémon changes its appearance if it hears\nits allies calling for help. Palafin will never show\nanybody its moment of transformation.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_935_000
entries.text: It protects itself from enemies by emitting oil\nfrom the fruit on its head. This oil is bitter and\nastringent enough to make someone flinch.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_936_000
entries.text: Dolliv shares its tasty, fresh-scented oil with\nothers. This species has coexisted with humans\nsince times long gone.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_937_000
entries.text: This calm Pokémon is very compassionate.\nIt will share its delicious, nutrient-rich oil\nwith weakened Pokémon.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_938_000
entries.text: The more sunlight this Pokémon bathes in, the\nmore spicy chemicals are produced by its body,\nand thus the spicier its moves become.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_939_000
entries.text: The red head converts spicy chemicals into fire\nenergy and blasts the surrounding area with a\nsuper spicy stream of flame.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_940_000
entries.text: Tadbulb shakes its tail to generate electricity.\nIf it senses danger, it will make its head blink on\nand off to alert its allies.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_941_000
entries.text: When this Pokémon expands and contracts its\nwobbly body, the belly-button dynamo in its\nstomach produces a huge amount of electricity.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_942_000
entries.text: It is said that this Pokémon was born when an\nunknown poison Pokémon entered and inspirited\nan engine left at a scrap-processing factory.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_943_000
entries.text: It creates a gas out of poison and minerals from\nrocks. It then detonates the gas in its cylinders—\nnow numbering eight—to generate energy.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_944_000
entries.text: When attacked, this Pokémon will wield\nthe tendrils on its body like fists and pelt\nthe opponent with a storm of punches.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_945_000
entries.text: Exhibiting great teamwork, they use their incisors\nto cut pieces out of any material that might be\nuseful for a nest, then make off with them.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_946_000
entries.text: They build huge nests with many rooms that\nare used for different purposes, such as eating\nand sleeping.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_947_000
entries.text: This species left the ocean and began living\non land a very long time ago. It seems to be\nclosely related to Wailmer.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_948_000
entries.text: This Pokémon wanders around snowy,\nicy areas. It protects its body with powerful\nmuscles and a thick layer of fat under its skin.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_949_000
entries.text: Frigibax absorbs heat through its dorsal fin and\nconverts the heat into ice energy. The higher the\ntemperature, the more energy Frigibax stores.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_950_000
entries.text: Arctibax freezes the air around it, protecting its\nface with an ice mask and turning its dorsal fin\ninto a blade of ice.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_951_000
entries.text: This Pokémon blasts cryogenic air out from\nits mouth. This air can instantly freeze even\nliquid-hot lava.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_952_000
entries.text: This is a small dragon Pokémon. It lives inside the\nmouth of Dondozo to protect itself from enemies\non the outside.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_953_000
entries.text: Apparently Cyclizar has been allowing people to\nride on its back since ancient times. Depictions of\nthis have been found in 10,000-year-old murals.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_954_000
entries.text: It has underdeveloped electric sacs on its cheeks.\nThese sacs can produce electricity only if Pawmi\nrubs them furiously with the pads on its forepaws.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_955_000
entries.text: When its group is attacked, Pawmo is the first\nto leap into battle, defeating enemies with a\nfighting technique that utilizes electric shocks.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_956_000
entries.text: This Pokémon normally is slow to react, but once\nit enters battle, it will strike down its enemies\nwith lightning-fast movements.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_957_000
entries.text: When its wings catch the wind, the bones within\nproduce electricity. This Pokémon dives into the\nocean, catching prey by electrocuting them.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_958_000
entries.text: Kilowattrel inflates its throat sac to amplify its\nelectricity. By riding the wind, this Pokémon can\nfly over 430 miles in a day.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_959_000
entries.text: It gathers things up in an apron made from shed\nfeathers added to the Pokémon’s chest feathers,\nthen drops those things from high places for fun.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_960_000
entries.text: These Pokémon prefer to live in cities.\nThey form flocks based on the color of\ntheir feathers, and they fight over territory.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_961_000
entries.text: This Pokémon apparently ties the base of its neck\ninto a knot so that energy stored in its belly does\nnot escape from its beak.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_962_000
entries.text: Klawf hangs upside-down from cliffs, waiting\nfor prey. But Klawf can’t remain in this position\nfor long because its blood rushes to its head.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_963_000
entries.text: It was born in a layer of rock salt deep under the\nearth. This species was particularly treasured in\nthe old days, as they would share precious salt.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_964_000
entries.text: This Pokémon dry cures its prey by spraying salt\nover them. The curing process steals away the\nwater in the prey’s body.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_965_000
entries.text: Garganacl will rub its fingertips together and\nsprinkle injured Pokémon with salt. Even severe\nwounds will promptly heal afterward.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_966_000
entries.text: It absorbs nutrients from cave walls. The petals\nit wears are made of crystallized poison.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_967_000
entries.text: When this Pokémon detects danger, it will open\nup its crystalline petals and fire beams from its\nconical body.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_968_000
entries.text: Though usually a mellow Pokémon, it will sink its\nsharp, poison-soaked front teeth into any that\nanger it, causing paralysis in the object of its ire.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_969_000
entries.text: The color of the poisonous saliva depends on\nwhat the Pokémon eats. Grafaiai covers its fingers\nin its saliva and draws patterns on trees in forests.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_970_000
entries.text: This Pokémon is smooth and moist to the touch.\nYeast in Fidough’s breath induces fermentation in\nthe Pokémon’s vicinity.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_971_000
entries.text: The pleasant aroma that emanates from this\nPokémon’s body helps wheat grow, so Dachsbun\nhas been treasured by farming villages.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_972_000
entries.text: It always scowls in an attempt to make opponents\ntake it seriously, but even crying children will\nburst into laughter when they see Maschiff’s face.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_973_000
entries.text: This Pokémon can store energy in its large\ndewlap. Mabosstiff unleashes this energy all\nat once to blow away enemies.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_974_000
entries.text: A soul unable to move on to the afterlife was\nblown around by the wind until it got tangled\nup with dried grass and became a Pokémon.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_975_000
entries.text: It will open the branches of its head to envelop\nits prey. Once it absorbs all the life energy it\nneeds, it expels the prey and discards it.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_976_000
entries.text: This Pokémon was born inside a treasure chest\nabout 1,500 years ago. It sucks the life-force\nout of scoundrels who try to steal the treasure.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_977_000
entries.text: Its body seems to be made up of 1,000 coins.\nThis Pokémon gets along well with others and is\nquick to make friends with anybody.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_978_000
entries.text: Sightings of this Pokémon have occurred\nin recent years. The name Great Tusk was\ntaken from a creature listed in a certain book.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_979_000
entries.text: It is possible that the creature listed as\nBrute Bonnet in a certain book could\nactually be this Pokémon.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_980_000
entries.text: This ferocious creature is shrouded in mystery.\nIt’s named after an aquatic monster mentioned\nin an old expedition journal.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_981_000
entries.text: No records exist of this Pokémon being caught.\nData is lacking, but the Pokémon’s traits match\nup with a creature shown in an expedition journal.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_982_000
entries.text: There has been only one reported sighting of this\nPokémon. It resembles a mysterious creature\ndepicted in an old expedition journal.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_983_000
entries.text: This Pokémon has characteristics similar to those\nof Flutter Mane, a creature mentioned in a\ncertain book.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_984_000
entries.text: This mysterious Pokémon has some similarities\nto a creature that an old book introduced as\nSlither Wing.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_985_000
entries.text: It is possible that this is the creature\nlisted as Roaring Moon in an expedition\njournal that still holds many mysteries.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_986_000
entries.text: This Pokémon closely resembles a scientific\nweapon that a paranormal magazine claimed\nwas sent to this planet by aliens.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_987_000
entries.text: Many of its physical characteristics match those\nof a Virizion from the future that was covered in\na paranormal magazine.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_988_000
entries.text: This Pokémon resembles an unknown object\ndescribed in a paranormal magazine as a UFO\nsent to observe humanity.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_989_000
entries.text: It is very similar to a cyborg covered exclusively\nby a paranormal magazine. The cyborg was said\nto be the modified form of a certain athlete.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_990_000
entries.text: It resembles a certain Pokémon introduced in a\nparanormal magazine, described as the offspring\nof a Hydreigon that fell in love with a robot.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_991_000
entries.text: It has some similarities to a Pokémon introduced\nin a dubious magazine as a Tyranitar from one\nbillion years into the future.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_992_000
entries.text: Its shape is similar to a robot featured in a\nparanormal magazine article. The robot was said\nto have been created by an ancient civilization.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_993_000
entries.text: It has some similarities to a mad scientist’s\ninvention covered in a paranormal magazine.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_994_000
entries.text: The fear poured into an ancient ritual vessel\nhas clad itself in rocks and dirt to become\na Pokémon.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_995_000
entries.text: This Pokémon can control 100 tons of\nfallen snow. It plays around innocently by\nleaping in and out of avalanches it has caused.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_996_000
entries.text: The grudge of a person punished for writing the\nking’s evil deeds upon wooden tablets has clad\nitself in dead leaves to become a Pokémon.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_997_000
entries.text: It controls flames burning at over 5,400 degrees\nFahrenheit. It casually swims through the sea of\nlava it creates by melting rock and sand.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_998_000
entries.text: This seems to be the Winged King mentioned\nin an old expedition journal. It was said to have\nsplit the land with its bare fists.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_999_000
entries.text: Much remains unknown about this\ncreature. It resembles Cyclizar, but it\nis far more ruthless and powerful.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_1000_000
entries.text: It swings its handmade hammer around to protect\nitself, but the hammer is often stolen by Pokémon\nthat eat metal.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_1001_000
entries.text: This Pokémon will attack groups of Pawniard and\nBisharp, gathering metal from them in order to\ncreate a large and sturdy hammer.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_1002_000
entries.text: This intelligent Pokémon has a very daring\ndisposition. It knocks rocks into the sky with\nits hammer, aiming for flying Corviknight.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_1003_000
entries.text: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a\nPokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit,\nCharcadet will battle even tough opponents.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_1004_000
entries.text: Armarouge evolved through the use of a set of\narmor that belonged to a distinguished warrior.\nThis Pokémon is incredibly loyal.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_1005_000
entries.text: The fiery blades on its arms burn fiercely with the\nlingering resentment of a sword wielder who fell\nbefore accomplishing their goal.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_1006_000
entries.text: Toedscool lives in muggy forests. The flaps that\nfall from its body are chewy and very delicious.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_1007_000
entries.text: These Pokémon gather into groups and form\ncolonies deep within forests. They absolutely\nhate it when strangers approach.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_1008_000
entries.text: Only a Bisharp that stands above all others in\nits vast army can evolve into Kingambit.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_1009_000
entries.text: When attacked, this Pokémon will retaliate\nby sticking thick spines out from its body. It’s\na risky move that puts everything on the line.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_1010_000
entries.text: When its anger rose beyond a critical point,\nthis Pokémon gained power that is unfettered\nby the limits of its physical body.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_1011_000
entries.text: This Pokémon’s type changes based on which\nmask it’s wearing. It confounds its enemies with\nnimble movements and kicks.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_1012_000
entries.text: Dipplin is two creatures in one Pokémon.\nIts evolution was triggered by a special apple\ngrown only in one place.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_1013_000
entries.text: Seven syrpents live inside an apple made\nof syrup. The syrpent in the center is the\ncommander.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_1014_000
entries.text: After all its muscles were stimulated by\nthe toxic chain around its neck, Okidogi\ntransformed and gained a powerful physique.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_1015_000
entries.text: The chain is made from toxins that enhance\ncapabilities. It stimulated Munkidori’s brain and\ncaused the Pokémon’s psychic powers to bloom.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_1016_000
entries.text: Fezandipiti owes its beautiful looks and lovely\nvoice to the toxic stimulants emanating from the\nchain wrapped around its body.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_1017_000
entries.text: There are scant few reports of this creature\nbeing sighted. One short video shows it\nrampaging and spouting pillars of flame.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_1018_000
entries.text: It’s said to incinerate everything around it with\nlightning launched from its fur. Very little is\nknown about this creature.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_1019_000
entries.text: It resembles a mysterious object introduced in a\nparanormal magazine as a cutting-edge weapon\nshaped like a Cobalion.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_1020_000
entries.text: It resembles a Pokémon described in a\ndubious magazine as a Terrakion that had\nbeen modified by an evil organization.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_1021_000
entries.text: Terapagos protects itself using its power to\ntransform energy into hard crystals. This Pokémon\nis the source of the Terastal phenomenon.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_1022_000
entries.text: It feeds others toxic mochi that draw out desires\nand capabilities. Those who eat the mochi fall\nunder Pecharunt’s control, chained to its will.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_1023_000
entries.text: It gathers static electricity from its surroundings.\nThe beams it launches when down on all fours\nare tremendously powerful.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_1024_000
entries.text: Supposedly, the regrets of a tea ceremony master\nwho died before perfecting his craft lingered in\nsome matcha and became a Pokémon.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_1025_000
entries.text: It pretends to be tea, trying to fool people into\ndrinking it so it can drain their life-force. Its ruse\nis generally unsuccessful.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_901_001
entries.text: It crossed the sea and drifted ashore in a new\nland. Surviving in this place led it to take on a\nunique appearance and gain special powers.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_902_001
entries.text: The souls of its comrades cloak its body and\npropel it effortlessly through even raging rapids.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_916_001
entries.text: This Pokémon sends a flowerlike scent wafting\nabout. Well-developed muscles in its legs allow it\nto leap more than 16 feet with no trouble at all.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_917_001
entries.text: The gentle Dudunsparce will put Pokémon\nthat wander into its nest onto its back and\ncarry them to the entrance.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_934_001
entries.text: This Pokémon’s ancient genes have awakened.\nIt is now so extraordinarily strong that it can\neasily lift a cruise ship with one fin.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_946_001
entries.text: The two little ones just appeared one day.\nThe group might be a family of related\nPokémon, but nobody knows for sure.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_952_001
entries.text: This species’ differing colors and patterns are\napparently the result of Tatsugiri changing itself\nto suit the preferences of the prey it lures in.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_952_002
entries.text: Bird Pokémon are its main prey. This Pokémon\nknows it’s weak, so it hunts with a partner.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_960_001
entries.text: The largest of their flocks can contain more\nthan 50 individuals. They fly around towns and\nforests, searching for food and making a racket.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_960_002
entries.text: These Squawkabilly are hotheaded, and their\nfighting style is vicious. They’ll leap within reach\nof their foes to engage in close combat.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_960_003
entries.text: This Pokémon dislikes being alone. It has a\nstrong sense of community and survives by\ncooperating with allies.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_976_001
entries.text: This Pokémon was born from passion that seeped\ninto a coin. It wanders, apparently seeking to\nreturn to the treasure chest it once inhabited.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_998_001
entries.text: The ecology and other data about this Pokémon\nare unknown. It was named Koraidon by the\nprofessor who discovered it.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_999_001
entries.text: Its characteristics match those of a mysterious\nobject recorded in an old expedition journal as\nthe Iron Serpent.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_1011_001
entries.text: This form excels in both attack and defense.\nIt ceaselessly unleashes moves like a spring\ngushes water.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_1011_002
entries.text: This form is the most aggressive, bombarding\nenemies with the intensity of flames blazing\nwithin a hearth.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_1011_003
entries.text: This form has excellent defenses, absorbing\nimpacts solidly like the cornerstones that support\nhouses.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_1021_001
entries.text: Upon sensing danger, it prepares itself for\nbattle by creating a sturdy shell of crystallized\nTerastal energy.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_1021_002
entries.text: In this form, Terapagos resembles the world\nas the ancients saw it, and its Terastal energy\nis abnormally amplified.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_1024_001
entries.text: It sprinkles some of its powdery body onto food\nand drains the life-force from those who so much\nas lick it.

entries.label: ZKN_COMMENT_A_1025_001
entries.text: It lives inside a superb teacup that was crafted\nby a potter of great renown. Collectors positively\nadore this Pokémon.
